message.content:
Here are some of the most prominent airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic, connectivity, and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Key gateway to Asia, Oceania, and Latin America; major hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports worldwide. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United Airlines and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York, NY | JFK | Primary gateway to Europe and the Caribbean; major hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Major hub for United Airlines and a key gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle‑Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; primary gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; high volume of domestic flights. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; key gateway to theme parks and leisure travel. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; close proximity to New York City. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | Washington, DC | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the nation's capital. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) | Detroit, MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; high domestic traffic. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger numbers, flight operations, and international connectivity. They serve as major hubs for the largest U.S. carriers and are critical nodes in both domestic and global air transport networks.
